state.$description: Opacities of interaction states that components apply themselves. Hover, pressed and selected colors are color tokens of their own (color.bg, color.fg, color.border). Numbers with the cssUnit extension are percentages.

dialog-overlay-opacity.$description: The opacity of the scrim (color.bg.overlay) behind a dialog.

fill-opacity.$description: The weight of the text color in the fill of an avatar group’s overflow count, which mixes it into the surrounding ring color.
